newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sekisui House prnt current profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: Sekisui House prnt current profit seen up.

text.p: Japanese home builder Sekisui House Ltd is expected to post a parent current profit of 40 billion yen in the six months to July 30, 1996, up five percent from a year ago, and the upward trend is seen continuing for the full business year, a Japanese newspaper said on Friday.

The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that it expected Sekisui's parent current profit in 1996/97 to rise 11 percent year-on-year to more than 80 billion yen. The expected rise is due to robust demand for houses because of low interest rates on housing loans, which consumers think might increase some time in the near future, the paper said.
